variants.long75: same full-RNJ start and original selection; search cap 25 to 75s
variants.multistart75: two extra contracted/refitted validation-ranked starts, with final-model scoring/refits
variants.multistart_original_rule: same extra search trajectories but original selection and contraction rule
variants.multistart_ac_gate: adopt original-rule multistart only if validation AC RMSE decreases more than 3 percent

AC_gate.test: original test, frozen training AC parameters

derived_variant_scope: last two variants use saved trajectories only; no new structure search; separated after observing bundled scoring patches can degrade topology
